stemMd: A courier must visit each of four offices once. One specified office must be visited last. How many orders are possible?
explanationMd: Fix the last office. The remaining three can be permuted in $3!=6$ ways.

distractorRationale.a: Counts choices for the first position only.
distractorRationale.d: Does not enforce the final-office restriction.
distractorRationale.c: Treats two different last offices as allowed.
